summary: Diff shows work in Provider Profile page and React Query hooks, plus backend type/model edits. However, due to truncation, only parts of the summary/edit flow are evidenced; several acceptance-criteria items (especially bio-data locking + helper text + backend enforcement and specific UI behaviors) are not clearly demonstrated in the provided diff summary. Additionally, the diff includes multiple changes (OTP messaging, location update hooks, engagement toggling) that are not requested by REQ-91..95.

missing_requirements.requirement: Default Provider Profile view is a read-only summary with key provider details (Name, Service Category, Hourly Rate, Phone Number, Description, Pinned Location, Engagement Status) and no editable inputs by default.
missing_requirements.reason: ProviderProfilePage.tsx shows editMode state defaulting to false, but the diff snippet does not include the rendered JSX for the default view, so it does not confirm a read-only summary with the required fields and no inputs.

missing_requirements.requirement: Summary view has a visible “Change Info” button that enters edit mode, and a clear way to cancel/exit edit mode without saving and discard local changes.
missing_requirements.reason: The file shows editMode state and a handleEnterEditMode function, but the truncated snippet does not show a rendered button labeled exactly “Change Info” nor a Cancel path that discards unsaved edits.

missing_requirements.requirement: In edit mode, show an “Update/Save Changes” button enabled only when changes exist; disabled during save; success returns to summary with English success message; failure stays in edit mode with English error; data refetch/invalidation after save.
missing_requirements.reason: useQueries.ts mentions a provider profile update mutation (per file summary) but the provided truncated code does not show the actual update mutation implementation or cache invalidation; ProviderProfilePage.tsx truncation does not show the Update button enable/disable logic, save-in-progress behavior, or success/error UI behavior.

missing_requirements.requirement: Bio-data fields are read-only in UI (even in edit mode) and backend rejects/ignores attempts to overwrite bio-data; include English helper text explaining bio-data cannot be changed because taken from an ID document; do not break onboarding/creation flows.
missing_requirements.reason: No bio-data fields or helper text are evidenced in the ProviderProfilePage.tsx snippet. Backend enforcement is not evidenced in backend/main.mo snippet (only type definitions shown; no update logic). Therefore the UI lock + server-side restriction + helper text cannot be confirmed from the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove/replace outdated Provider Profile copy about editing being available in a future update; ensure messaging matches new Change Info + Update flow in English.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary does not show removal of the specific outdated copy nor the new guidance text; ProviderProfilePage.tsx rendering is truncated.
